id: Risk uses the four values the app renders: low / watch / high / critical. If your system only has three levels, medium is accepted and maps to watch.

Customer segment and the collection note are not columns. They are derived from the invoice amount and its aging. Edit SEGMENT_BAND_ENTERPRISE, SEGMENT_BAND_MID_MARKET and AGING_NOTES in src/data/finance-data.ts to change how.
Payroll per opex category is not a column either. It is derived from PAYROLL_SHARE_BY_OPEX in the same file.
The 13-week forecast is derived from these months and invoices. There is nothing extra to supply, but review the assumption constants at the top of the data file.
